topic: Compilation of Lamine Yamal top performances (starting vs Inter 2025 home game), long-form with commentary
hook: Title card "vs INTER HOME 2025" over Yamal portrait/walk-out, then glitch/datamosh transition into match footage
subtitle_style: White bold sans "vs INTER" with small yellow-ish subtitle "HOME 2025", lower-left of frame, chapter-style; no running subtitles
reaction_overlays: CT corner logo watermark top-right on every frame; glitch/datamosh pixel-block transition; no emoji
transition_summary: Hard cuts between wide tactical-cam clips and occasional close-ups; slow rhythm ~1-2 cuts per 10 s (cuts list sparse), one glitch transition at 2.9 s
audio_note: Original match commentary (English) over broadcast footage, chapter intro line in commentary; no obvious music

reuse_segments.what: Champions League Barcelona vs Inter broadcast highlights (Yamal dribbles/shots)
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: needs licensed source or recreate with generated pitch visuals; strip CT watermark and commentary
